gemini.rationale: The acquirer's FY2022 Form 10-K shows that all 12 acquired gaming properties continued to operate roughly four years after closing, integrated into the acquirer's regional reporting segments. There is no documented evidence of product/process disruption or process/organization fracture, nor any divestitures or impairments related to the acquired properties.

grok.rationale: The FY2022 10-K lists all 12 former-Pinnacle properties as still operating and folded into Penn's Northeast/South/West/Midwest segments, with no documented divestiture, closure, or Pinnacle-attributable impairment. Nothing in the slice records product/process misalignment or operations-vs-organization fracture over the 3-5-year horizon; absence of such realized-disruption evidence codes p4_pathway and p5_pathway as 0.
